descriptionChirho: The proper name Er, primarily referring to the firstborn son of Judah who was wicked in God's sight and was put to death (Gen 38:3,6-7, 46:12, Num 26:19, 1 Chr 2:3), and also an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus (1 Chr 4:21, Luke 3:28). Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'Er,' spa 'Er,' hin 'er,' arb 'iiiru,' kor 'el/ereu,' swa 'Eri/Era.' The prepositional prefix form (le- + Er, 'for Er') is syntactic, not a distinct sense of the name.
